steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX projects for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Provide the required event title.
Create the Technical and RFQ stages required by the case.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add one item for the event.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor for the vendor-side check.
Publish the configured two-stage event.
Verify that the event reached a real published project page.
Open the invited QA vendor portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's Technical stage in the vendor portal.
Verify the first mandatory clause is shown to the vendor.
Verify the second mandatory clause is shown to the vendor.
Accept only one of the mandatory clauses.
Submission should remain blocked while one mandatory clause is unchecked.
Accept the remaining mandatory clause.
Submission should become available after both clauses are accepted.
Submit the completed Technical-stage response.
Verify the vendor's Technical-stage submission succeeded.
Open the RFQ pricing stage to verify stage-only applicability.
The Technical-stage clause must not be requested on the RFQ stage.
The second Technical-stage clause must not be requested on the RFQ stage.
